text:
Maya Lopez: Follow-up from the postmortem: we need a compact tracker for the KV-cache OOM work. Goal: assign owners, timelines, and clear rollback criteria. Short thread to lock this down.
Ethan Ruiz: I'll own the reproducibility and profiling artifacts. Plan: nightly jemalloc snapshots + perf flamegraphs and a small churn runner. ETA: 72 hours for first artifacts.
Priya Desai: Runtime will own mitigations (soft caps, compaction, emergency reject). I'll prototype soft_cap + background incremental compaction behind a feature flag. ETA: 12 days for prototype PR.
Maya Lopez: Action items summary:
  - Ethan: repro harness + nightlies (ETA 3d)
  - Priya: soft_cap + compactor PR (ETA 12d)
  - Tom B. (observability): dashboards and alerts (ETA 4d)
  - ops-bot: schedule canary 5% after PR merge
ci-bot: Reminder: add leak sanitizer to CI for the key-snapshot path once repro PR lands.
Ethan Ruiz: Repro notes: use churn_runner with varied object sizes and TTLs. Example:
```
./tools/churn_runner --shards=32 --sizes=128,2048,16384 --ttl=45 --duration=120
curl http://localhost:9100/debug/je_stats > /tmp/je_stats.json
```
Priya Desai: Compaction approach: incremental page migration first (low CPU) then slab rewrite if needed. Also adding per-shard soft_cap that backpressures writes (returns 429) when resident > soft_threshold. We'll log shard_id, resident_bytes, frag_ratio with the 429.
Tom B.: I'll build dashboard panels: per-shard resident_bytes, allocated_bytes, frag_ratio, compaction_runs, and 429 counts. Alert at host resident > 85% or frag_ratio > 1.2 sustained for 10m -> notify #eng-runtime and page on host growth > 10% in 10m.
Maya Lopez: Rollout plan: dev -> canary (5% for 2h) -> ramp to 25% if fragmentation delta < 2% and P95 latency unchanged. Abort if write rejections > 1% or error rate increases.
Ethan Ruiz: Found a suspicious early-return in the snapshot builder that can leak on error paths. Adding a unit test + CI sanitizer. PR will reference the postmortem.
Priya Desai: Also adding a per-shard hard_limit that will reject writes and emit a structured dump for offline analysis if resident exceeds hard_limit. Owner: runtime.
ops-bot: Canary will run after PR merge. Will post start/finish notices in this thread.
Maya Lopez: Weekly check-ins for the next 5 weeks on Fridays 11am to track telemetry and regressions. Priya to send invites.
Ethan Ruiz: PR opened for repro infra: perf/repro/1834100000-kv-churn. Nightly jobs scheduled; first flamegraph uploaded to the postmortem doc.
Priya Desai: Soft_cap prototype PR queued; requesting review from Maya and Ethan.
Maya Lopez: Thanks team. Please update the postmortem checklist with PR links and change item status to "in-progress" when you start. I'll consolidate progress and escalate blockers in the Friday sync. :white_check_mark:
